sources.description: The Tampa Bay Buccaneers are hosting the Minnesota Vikings this afternoon. The Bucs will be without edge rusher Rueben Bain Jr. again as he is still dealing with a groin injury. They will also be without cornerback Benjamin Morrison. You can see the rest of the inactives here. Kickoff is set for 1:00 PM EST. Enjoy each […]
